prompt: Produce exactly one concise natural‑language caption (a single sentence) that vividly and precisely describes the main subject(s), visible actions, and setting; use specific action verbs and name clear maneuvers, indicate movement direction(s) relative to the camera/frame using a consistent order—horizontal first (toward/away/left-to-right/right-to-left/past) then vertical (upward/downward)—and state whether motions are simultaneous or sequential; describe body posture with concrete terms (standing, slightly leaning forward/back, seated, reclining, crouching, mid-jump, arms outstretched, knees bent) rather than interpretive labels, and report facial expressions or visible affect only when clearly evident using observable detail (open‑mouthed, smiling with teeth visible, furrowed brow) while specifying gaze targets (e.g., "eyes looking up at the kite," "gaze fixed on the camera"); specify precise spatial relationships, scale, and proximity (next to, behind, in front of, atop, touching, a few feet/meters apart, clustered closely, spread apart, in a line) and clarify subjects’ positions relative to each other and to background elements (e.g., "a third person seated at the far end," "man across from him"); for gestures state the direction and intended target (e.g., "gesturing with his right hand toward the person across from him"); note the number and arrangement of people (isolated individual, a small group clustered on benches, a line of pedestrians) and describe interaction dynamics only when supported by clear visual cues (hugging, holding hands, reaching, petting); describe lighting and shadows with observable cues—light quality (diffuse/overcast, directional backlight, strong side light), where shadows fall (onto ground, faces, building), and approximate shadow direction or length (casting long shadows toward the lower left, faint soft shadows); include visible surface textures or effects such as wet pavement, puddles, splashes, reflections, motion blur, or dust when present; keep the caption concrete, image‑centered, and avoid speculation or subjective judgments, and output exactly one single sentence (no lists, tags, multiple candidates, or metadata).

Two women stand side-by-side at a wooden table with a yellow basin and bottles, one gesturing toward the other while both face a seated group of people under trees casting dappled shadows, as the audience watches attentively with some leaning forward and others seated in rows behind them.

A person mid-backflip, arms outstretched and legs bent, arcs upward and slightly leftward against a clear blue sky, above a golden sand dune where another figure stands a few meters away, kicking up dust as the sun casts long shadows toward the lower left.

A man in a blue shirt and loose pants, arms outstretched and slightly leaning forward while gripping a large yellow signboard covered in stickers, stands next to another man who is holding the sign’s edge, as pedestrians walk past them on a sunlit sidewalk with faint shadows cast onto the pavement.

An elderly man with a long white beard, standing upright and slightly leaning forward while playing a wooden flute with his right hand, gazes downward at his instrument as pedestrians walk past him on the sidewalk; a black folding stool and a case lie on the pavement beside him, and the building’s glass window reflects the overcast

A person seated cross-legged on a colorful woven blanket, wearing a traditional hat and patterned scarf, carefully handles a long sword with both hands while a pair of black shoes rests on the ground nearby, surrounded by textiles and bags under bright, direct sunlight casting sharp shadows.

A man seated on a folding chair in a narrow alleyway, his body angled slightly to his right with his gaze directed forward, remains still as a blue car parked behind him casts a shadow onto the wet pavement, while weathered walls and pipes frame the scene under diffuse daylight.

A black-and-white Border Collie, mid-jump with front paws extended forward and hind legs trailing upward, clears a red-and-white agility hurdle while a German Shepherd stands alert behind it, both dogs in motion against a backdrop of spectators and trees under diffuse daylight.

A woman crouching low on a paved sidewalk, smiling broadly with her gaze fixed on a small dog she’s gently petting, while a toddler in a floral dress stands beside her, reaching out toward the dog, and another woman seated nearby leans forward with a watchful smile, all clustered closely together under diffuse daylight

A goalkeeper in a red jersey dives leftward with arms outstretched toward a descending ball while a cluster of players in yellow and white jerseys, including one mid-jump with arms extended upward and another crouching with knees bent, contest the header simultaneously on a brightly lit green pitch, with spectators blurred in the background

Two men stand facing each other in a hallway with white walls displaying logos, one gesturing with his right hand toward the other while holding a red cup, and the other standing with his left hand raised near his chin, both appearing engaged in conversation as a third person walks away down the corridor to the right.
